title: \"Arquiteto de Cloud #996719\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

• Desenho de soluções: Elaborar diagramas e arquiteturas em nuvem garantindo alta disponibilidade, resiliência e SLA mínimo de 99,9%.

• Migração para cloud: Liderar estratégias de lift and shift, replatform ou refactoring de ambientes on-premise para Google Cloud.

• Governança: Definir e implementar padrões de nomenclatura, estrutura de tags, controle de acessos e políticas de segurança para todo o ambiente.

• Otimização de custos (FinOps): Realizar análises recorrentes de consumo, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos e eliminação de desperdícios.


Experiência :

• Domínio dos core services do Google Cloud: Experiência avançada com Compute Engine, GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Cloud Run e VPC Networking.

• Dados & Analytics: Vivência com BigQuery, Pub/Sub e Dataflow em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e altamente escaláveis.

• Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Forte atuação com Terraform (preferencialmente) ou Google Cloud Deployment Manager.

• Segurança & IAM: Implementação de políticas de least privilege, gestão de identidades (Cloud Identity) e utilização de Shared VPC.

• FinOps: Capacidade de monitorar, analisar e otimizar custos utilizando Google Cloud Billing e Recommender.

• Mentoria técnica: Atuação no desenvolvimento e evolução técnica de engenheiros e desenvolvedores.

• Inglês (nível avançado/ótima conversação)


Diferencial:

• Certificação Google Professional Cloud Architect (altamente recomendada) ou Professional Data Engineer.

• Experiência com ambientes multicloud ou híbridos, utilizando Anthos.

• Implementação de pipelines de CI/CD com Cloud Build, GitHub Actions ou GitLab CI.


Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido

title: Coordenador de Manutenção
description:
Para a posição de Coordenador de Manutenção, a atuação será voltada ao suporte das operações, com foco no acompanhamento de rotinas administrativas e operacionais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar, programar e controlar as atividades de manutenção e grandes paradas de acordo com o programa de manutenção e com as prioridades operacionais;
  • Coordenar e garantir recursos humanos, materiais, peças, ferramentas e insumos necessários para a execução das tarefas de manutenção que necessitam do suporte de terra;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia de Produção, Mecânica, Automação, Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou Naval;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Experiência com gestão de equipes;
  • Experiência no setor marítimo ou offshore.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em operações oceanográficas, metrologia, desenho técnico, testes e ensaios e demais recursos utilizados nos equipamentos;
  • Conhecimento em auditorias de sociedades classificadoras (ABS e DNV);
  • Conhecimento em Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção, Noções em Ciências navais e Navegação, Mecânica de propulsores e Lemes, Máquinas navais, Turbinas Sistemas de automação, Sistema de geração de energia, Sistemas hidráulicos, sistema de arrefecimento, Eletrônica, comunicação de rádios VHF e SSB e sistema Vsat;
  • Conhecimento em Serviços técnicos de produção, manutenção de sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos, vedações, montagens, conhecimento de sistemas offshore e operações dentro dos padrões técnicos;
  • Conhecimento em análise de causa raíz e/ou ferramentas de qualidade: 5W2H, diagrama de Ishikawa, diagrama de Pareto.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.

  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.


Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado

description:
Vaga exclusiva para mulheres (cis e trans). Candidaturas devem ser enviadas para , contendo carta de apresentação, + currículo. Não serão analisadas candidaturas enviadas por outros canais.



A Empodera está à procura de uma pessoa dinâmica, organizada e motivada para coordenar nosso time administrativo-financeiro e trabalhar para o empoderamento e garantia de direitos de meninas e mulheres.

A coordenadora administrativa-financeira pleno é a responsável, juntamente com a gestão executiva, por analisar, gerenciar e implementar sistemas e processos administrativos e financeiros eficientes e transparentes na organização. Ela é responsável pela coordenação e acompanhamento da equipe da área, pela elaboração de orçamentos e relatórios de prestação de contas, controle de fluxo de caixa e conciliação bancária. Além disso, desenvolverá processos integrados, que aumentam a eficiência e a eficácia da organização, em um ambiente empreendedor e colaborativo. 


A Empodera incentiva fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas negras, indígenas, pessoas vivendo com HIV/AIDS, pessoas LGBTI+ e com deficiência.


Quem somos

Fundada em 2017, a Empodera – Transformação Social pelo Esporte é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos com sede no Rio de Janeiro e atuação nacional, que utiliza o esporte e jogos lúdicos como ferramenta para que meninas adolescentes em situação de vulnerabilidade social exerçam seu pleno potencial e direitos. As ações da organização são focadas em promover a redução dos estereótipos nocivos e da violência baseados no gênero. A Empodera trabalha com o desenvolvimento e execução de metodologias esportivas, treinamentos e suporte técnico de organizações em prol de uma sociedade mais justa e equânime.

  • Supervisionar a  conciliação bancária de acordo com o fluxo de pagamento semanal
  • Fornecer atualizações sobre despesas por centro de custo/projeto, bem como outras informações financeiras em tempo hábil e preciso

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Coordenadora Financeira
description:
Atividades e Requisitos:


  • Liderança e gestão do time:

•Definir a estratégia operacional da tesouraria e desdobrar em rotinas, responsabilidades (RACI), metas e SLAs do time.

•Garantir padronização de critérios e entregáveis entre holding e SPEs, reduzindo assimetria de processos e informações.

•Atuar como segunda linha de checagem para entregas críticas produzidas pelo time.


  • Governança do caixa e liquidez (Holding + SPEs):

•Estabelecer e revisar a política de nível mínimo de caixa por empresa/SPE e consolidado, considerando restrições contratuais, reservas, garantias e cronogramas de dívida.

•Coordenar a consolidação da posição diária/semanal de caixa e alavancar visões por SPE.

•Conduzir fóruns/comitês de caixa, com recomendações objetivas: alocação de liquidez, priorização de desembolsos, timing de captações e pré-pagamentos.


  • Gestão e previsibilidade do fluxo de caixa:

•Garantir a qualidade do cash forecast consolidado, com premissas formalizadas e trilha de atualização.

•Supervisionar análises de desvios projetado vs. realizado e assegurar planos de ação.

•Promover consistência entre previsões de caixa, planejamento financeiro, CAPEX dos projetos e restrições regulatórias/contratuais das SPEs.


  • Endividamento: estratégia, captação e gestão do portfólio:

•Liderar, em nível de coordenação, o pipeline de captações, refinanciamentos e renegociações, garantindo estrutura alinhada à estratégia do grupo, governança de aprovações e materiais executivos para decisão.

•Supervisionar a gestão do mapa da dívida consolidado (holding e SPEs).

•Implementar rotina robusta de monitoramento de covenants, com alertas antecipados e planos de mitigação.


  • Gestão de riscos financeiros e hedges:

•Definir e manter a estratégia de gestão de riscos financeiros, com limites e métricas.

•Supervisionar recomendação/execução de hedges, assegurando aderência à política, documentação, contrapartes e monitoramento de efetividade.

•Conduzir análises executivas de sensibilidade e recomendar ações.


  • Relacionamento bancário e gestão de contrapartes:

•Atuar como ponto focal executivo no relacionamento com bancos: estratégia de relacionamento, negociação de condições estruturais, seleção de instituições e diversificação.

•Garantir governança de limites por contraparte, avaliação de risco e aderência a políticas internas.


  • Controles internos, compliance e auditorias:

•Assegurar segregação de funções, controles de acesso, trilhas de aprovação e rotinas de conciliação.

•Ser o responsável pela preparação e sustentação de evidências para auditorias em temas de tesouraria, dívida e hedge.

•Atualizar/implementar políticas e procedimentos corporativos, com treinamento do time e aderência pelas SPEs.


  • Melhoria contínua e transformação:

•Priorizar e liderar roadmap de melhorias com TI e fornecedores.

•Definir padrões de dados e relatórios financeiros.


  • Expectativas para o cargo:

•Recomendar estratégia de caixa, funding e hedge para aprovação do gerente executivo.

•Fazer avaliação constante de riscos para auxiliar na melhor tomada de decisão e geração de valor ao negócio.

•Aprovar rotinas e parâmetros operacionais dentro de limites, conforme política.

•Negociar condições com bancos e coordenar RFPs/concorrências, submetendo decisões finais às instâncias de aprovação.

• Conhecimento no sistema SAP;

• Pacote office;

• Power Bi;

description:

Department: Success Department

About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.


Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.


We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!


Our Culture

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!


Role Description

At Respond.io, the role of Customer Success Manager is pivotal to our company's success. As a Customer Success Manager, you will be the go-to resource for top-tier customers to ensure successful product adoption and retention. This role entails handling clients onboarding, clients retention, and success planning.


Our ideal candidate will have the experience of working in a B2B SaaS company, and handling a fair share of different business processes. We are seeking someone who can ensure that our clients receive a great experience while working with us.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with customers to understand their goals and help them maximize the value of the Respond.io platform
  • Assist customers during the onboarding process, ensuring a positive and smooth experience
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders
  • Act as a point of contact for customer issues and ensure timely resolution
  • Gain a deep understanding of customer needs, use cases, and objectives to ensure effective utilization of the Respond.io platform
  • Monitor and report on customer satisfaction and platform usage
  • Focus on maintaining high customer satisfaction and retention rates
  • Acquire in-depth knowledge of the Respond.io platform and identify opportunities for customer growth, collaborating with the internal team to propose upsells


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of B2B SaaS experience in Customer Success, Consulting, and Account Management
  • Experienced in working with international customers and handling global accounts
  • Attentive listener with an ability to address customer concerns effectively
  • Strong communication skills in Arabic and English to convey complex ideas clearly
  • Skilled in negotiating complex renewal contracts in a SaaS environment
  • Proficient in optimizing complex business processes
  • Familiarity with business messaging platforms, CRM systems, and Customer Success tools
  • Passionate about digital transformation and understanding diverse businesses
  • Ability to provide customer feedback and insights to various departments for product improvement
  • Deep understanding of our products, industry trends, and competition
  • Able to quickly grasp technical concepts and keen to become an expert in our software
  • An agile team player who is excited by the fast-paced start-up environment and is eager to make a difference


Here's what's in for you

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like talent shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
  • We offer a highly competitive compensation package.
  • You'll receive a medical allowance to support your health and wellness needs.
  • Flexible working environment and working hours that fit your lifestyle, wherever you're based.

About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.


Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!

At Respond.io, Technical Customer Support are pivotal to our company’s success. You will be the go-to resource for our valued customers to obtain clarification when needed, provide best solution, and support any technical matters. In this role, your main priority is to drive excellent support and maintain customer satisfaction.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver high-quality support to customers of our SaaS product
  • Communicate and respond to varied technical business solutions to customers in a team environment, using our shared inbox tool to assist with customer inquiries
  • Resolve customer inquiries in a timely manner using full understanding of the product value, functions, features, and customer’s business needs
  • Monitor common customer questions/concerns and partner with cross-functional teams to suggest solutions

  • Work collaboratively across teams — Customer, Marketing, Product, and Tech — to solve complex problems
  • Provide customer support via multiple channels including chat, and video calls

  • 2+ years of experience in a Customer Support role preferably in a SaaS or IT company

  • Ability to clearly explain complex ideas verbally and in writing
  • Ability to dig deeper to uncover customer’s true objectives
  • High level of empathy - it’s important for our Customer Support Associate to be a good person to peers and customers
  • Able to work in a fixed shift
  • Team-oriented mindset with a “thirst for more” attitude — always eager to learn, improve, and take on new challenges


Here's What's In For You

  • Virtual events like Talent Shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
The Recruiting Coordinator plays a critical role within the Talent Acquisition team at the client and is the convergence of all recruitment activity across the organization. This position is responsible for coordinating the logistics and execution of all recruitment activities at the client.


The Recruiting Coordinator is the front-line contact for all activity related to recruiting, and will work closely with a team of recruiters, hiring managers, the business line, external vendors, and candidates. The RC plays a key role in the talent acquisition team’s mission to ensure every candidate's experience in the job search process with the client is positive and meaningful.


Essential Skills Attention to detail: The RC needs to possess a strong eye for detail. The ideal candidate will create and own complex interview schedules that may include multiple locations, time zones and social mediums for conducting the interview (virtual and in-person).

It is crucial that the RC pays close attention to arrangements that often change, frequently at the last minute. In addition, the RC will draft important documentation (weekly reports, new hire paperwork, offer letters, proposals etc.) that have no margin for error.


Superior interpersonal skills: The ability to establish relationships with a broad range of individuals is critical. This position requires sound business judgment and maturity, and the ability to exercise appropriate discretion. The successful candidate will have a mature, professional, and polished demeanor. The RC will hold in the utmost confidence the details of every search process and protect the privacy of candidate personal data.


Intellectual Curiosity & Interest in Recruiting: The individual will have an active curiosity in recruiting, working with the broader talent acquisition team to assist in research, sourcing, candidate development, and a variety of talent acquisition related projects. In this regard, the CSS needs to demonstrate flexibility and a proactive demeanor


Responsibilities:

  • Provide recruitment support for a team of LoB recruiters including scheduling, coordinating, and facilitating in-person, phone, and video conference interviews
  • Create, collect, and compile feedback and manage briefing documents
  • Ensure data integrity and update candidate records in the applicant tracking system and HRIS as needed, including entering NDA documentation and relevant interview details
  • Manage logistics for the recruiting process, including travel arrangement, expense reimbursements, generating offer letters and ensuring background checks are 100% completed
  • Ensure every candidate experience working with the client is positive and leaves them feeling like they want to work here
  • Being the eyes and ears of the team, having the confidence to raise questions and make suggestions
  • Project based work across recruitment- we are enthusiastic about having a team member who has a growth mindset and is passionate about continuing to learn and evolve!


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years’ experience in an administrative, coordinator, client facing or customer service role
  • Ability to complete tasks with accuracy and speed
  • Eagerness to learn and the bravery to work through stages of ambiguity
  • Strong ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maturity

title: GenAI Engineer
description:
Sobre a vaga

A dhauz, empresa do grupo Quantum Rise, é empresa de serviços e soluções usando dados e inteligência artificial para suportar processos de tomada de decisão de negócios. Somos uma equipe interdisciplinar de profissionais formados nas melhores universidades do país e do exterior, com ampla experiência no mercado e prontos para auxiliar a transformação analítica de grandes marcas. E aí, curtiu? #VemSerUmHauzer


Quem estamos procurando

Buscamos um(a) GenAI Engineer para desenhar e entregar soluções de IA Generativa, usando LLMs existentes (comerciais e open models) — sem foco em treinar foundation models. Você vai atuar em iniciativas para clientes e produtos internos, integrando modelos, dados e sistemas corporativos, com atenção a métrica, segurança, confiabilidade e custo.

Procuramos alguém que goste de um ambiente com alto nível técnico, com espaço real para aprender, ensinar e construir boas práticas.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Construir aplicações GenAI usando LLMs (ex.: ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, Gemini/Google, etc)
  • Implementar fluxos end-to-end: prompting, tool/function calling, outputs estruturados, agentes e otimização de latência/custo
  • Criar e evoluir pipelines de RAG (ingestão, chunking, embeddings, busca vetorial e grounded responses)
  • Definir práticas de avaliação e qualidade (test sets, scoring automatizado, revisão humana e regressões)
  • Colocar guardrails: PII handling, mitigação de hallucination, prompt-injection awareness, filtros e fallbacks
  • Integrar com sistemas do cliente (APIs, bancos, repositórios de documentos, data warehouses, CRM/ERP, knowledge bases)


Requisitos (o que esperamos que você tenha)

  • Experiência construindo e deployando aplicações LLM-powered (RAG, prompting e tool/function calling)
  • Experiência prática com provedores e tooling de LLM (ex.: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) e trade-offs (custo, latência, limites)
  • Boa base de eval/monitoring e postura de segurança (PII, controles, riscos de prompt injection, SDLC seguro)
  • Inglês para conversação


Diferenciais

  • Capacidade de explicar trade-offs para stakeholders (qualidade x custo x prazo)
  • Mentalidade de produto: iterar, medir, melhorar continuamente via feedback loops
  • Experiência desenhando UX de human-in-the-loop e padrões de interação claros
  • Experiência criando aceleradores (templates, libs internas, reference implementations) para escalar entregas

Work Mode: Remote

Systems & Tools

  • Experience with Linux and Windows Server

Automation & Integration

  • Experience manipulating video, audio, and subtitles via APIs, JSON, or command line
  • Proficiency in creating or modifying JSON/XML workflows for transcoding and QC
  • Understanding of API protocols

Cloud

  • Experience working with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Ability to operate and test systems in cloud-based environments (Linux/Windows instances)

Soft Skills

  • Strong communication and customer service skills
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities
  • Ability to work in high-pressure, fast-paced environments


Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud-based transcoding systems

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant industry experience or equivalent academic experience in media workflows
  • Technical certifications are a plus

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Data Migration Lead (RTR)
description:
SAP S/4HANA Finance Data Migration Lead (RTR)

Greenfield Implementation | Data Governance | GL, Cost Center, Profit Center


We are hiring for the position from North America

12 months contract role ; May extend

Remote

Candidate need to have Short notice period

Candidate need to use own personal computer for work

Candidate need to support EST time zone for meetings


We pay monthly in US Dollars ; No benefits ; Wire transfer

Fulltime contract role ; 40hrs a week; 8 hrs a day


Candidate should have expertise with Governance as a data owner, Fixed Assets/Projects experience, and Inventory experience. Would also like the candidates to have strong experience on Greenfield data migration (validation, problem resolution).


Position Purpose:

Client is currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects.

Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference,

conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking

experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield

S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business

processes. This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose,

standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build,

migration, and adoption.


The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process

owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data

requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.


Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

• Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements

aligned to standardized value stream processes.

• Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data

definitions for S/4HANA.

• Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and

hierarchies across geographies.

• Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make,

Deliver, Return)


Functional Process Data Ownership

Responsibilities include:

• Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.

• Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.

• Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.


Data Migration & Readiness

• Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.

• Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.

• Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.

• Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.


Data Governance & Standards

• Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.

• Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.

• Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.

• Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.


Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

• Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.

• Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.

• Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.

• Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.


Required Qualifications

Experience

• 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).

• Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.

• Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.

• Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.


Technical & Functional Skills

• Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor/Business


Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).

• Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.

• Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.

• Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).

• Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.


Soft Skills

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams.

• Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment.


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.

• Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.

• Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.

• Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.


Candidates should have good decision making skills

Taking ownership of the project- Cutover process, mapping, testing, validation, conversion - master data

Would like someone hand-on but also functional - Mapping and testing of the conversion.

Set up cost center and cc groups, profit center groups

100% Remote

Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.

  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on AI Engineer with deep expertise in Large Language Model integration and production AI systems. This role will lead the design and implementation of LLM-powered capabilities within our platform, working closely with backend, mobile, and product teams.

This individual will own the end-to-end AI architecture, from model selection and prompt strategy to retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, cost optimization, and production deployment.

This is not a research role. It is a systems architecture and applied AI engineering role focused on building scalable, secure, real-world AI applications.

Key Responsibilities

LLM Architecture & Integration

  • Design and implement LLM-powered application workflows
  • Architect prompt orchestration, tool calling, and multi-step reasoning pipelines
  • Define model selection strategy (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, etc.)
  • Implement streaming responses for mobile and web clients
  • Optimize token usage and latency for production environments
  • Build fallback and resilience strategies across model providers

RAG & Knowledge Systems

  • Architect retrieval-augmented generation pipelines
  • Design vector database schema and embedding workflows
  • Implement chunking, metadata tagging, and indexing strategies
  • Optimize semantic search relevance
  • Integrate structured and unstructured data sources

AI Infrastructure & Backend Integration

  • Collaborate with backend architects to integrate AI services into APIs
  • Design asynchronous processing pipelines for AI workflows
  • Implement caching strategies for inference results
  • Architect evaluation and monitoring frameworks for LLM output quality
  • Build guardrails, moderation layers, and output validation

Model Evaluation & Performance

  • Define evaluation metrics for response quality
  • Implement automated testing for LLM outputs
  • Analyze hallucination patterns and mitigation techniques
  • Monitor drift, cost, and performance metrics
  • Continuously improve prompt and architecture strategies

Security & Governance

  • Implement data privacy safeguards
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise security requirements
  • Design safe handling of user-generated content
  • Implement access control and audit logging

Technical Leadership

  • Guide LLM architecture decisions across the platform
  • Mentor engineers working on AI-related components
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools and frameworks
  • Define long-term AI roadmap aligned with product strategy

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years in software engineering with at least 2+ years focused on LLM systems
  • Production experience integrating LLM APIs
  • Strong experience with:
  • Python (FastAPI preferred)
  • Vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)
  • Embeddings and semantic search
  • Prompt engineering and tool invocation workflows
  • Experience building RAG systems in production
  • Experience optimizing latency and inference costs
  • Strong understanding of tokenization, context windows, and model limitations
  • Experience deploying AI services in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks
  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks
  • Experience with evaluation tooling and benchmarking
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning or model adaptation techniques
  • Experience building AI features for mobile-first applications

Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

• Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements

aligned to standardized value stream processes.

definitions for S/4HANA.

• Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and

hierarchies across geographies.

Deliver, Return)

Responsibilities include:

• Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.

• Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.

• Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.


Data Migration & Readiness

• Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.

• Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.

• Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.


Data Governance & Standards

• Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.

• Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.

• Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.

• Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.


Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

• Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.

• Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.

• Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.


Required Qualifications

Experience

• 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).

• Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.

• Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.

• Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.

Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).

Soft Skills

The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

• Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

• SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.

• Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

• Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.

• Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements

• Data Handling: 1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.

• SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.

• Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).

• Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements

• Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.

• Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"noisy\" data, and propose actionable solutions.

• Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.

• Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

• Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.

• Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.

• Prior Forecasting experience


Location: LATAM (Must align with US PST Time Zone)


Language Requirement:

Advanced English


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

  • Participar ativamente da gestão e evolução da área de marketing digital.

Perfil desejado:

  • Experiência comprovada em crescimento orgânico de redes sociais.

Você soma com nosso crescimento!

O profissional atua de forma autônoma e consultiva, liderando tecnicamente demandas de média e alta complexidade, desenvolvimentos no ServiceNow App Engine / Low-Code , automações de workflows, integrações e iniciativas de automação e uso responsável de Inteligência Artificial , garantindo conformidade com políticas corporativas, requisitos de auditoria, segurança da informação e boas práticas de mercado (ITIL).


No seu dia a dia você focará em:

Sustentação e Operação ITSM

  • Atuar de forma sênior na sustentação da plataforma ServiceNow, garantindo estabilidade, desempenho, disponibilidade e qualidade das entregas;
  • Atuar nos processos de Incidentes, Requisições, Problemas e Mudanças (GMUD) , assegurando correta execução, priorização, categorização, registro e encerramento;
  • Atuar como ponto de escalonamento técnico para chamados de maior complexidade.

Evolução da Plataforma e Desenvolvimento

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter soluções utilizando ServiceNow App Engine / Low-Code;
  • Atuar com Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies e Catalog Items , garantindo aderência às boas práticas da plataforma;
  • Avaliar impactos técnicos e funcionais de mudanças, releases, upgrades e novas funcionalidades;
  • Conduzir e revisar testes técnicos e funcionais, garantindo qualidade antes de implantações em produção.

Análise, Melhoria Contínua e Governança

  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz (RCA) , propondo e implementando soluções definitivas para incidentes recorrentes.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos, dados e fluxos da plataforma;
  • Garantir aderência a controles internos, auditorias, compliance e segurança da informação.

Integrações, Automação e IA

  • Atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e sustentação de integrações entre ServiceNow e sistemas corporativos , utilizando IntegrationHub e APIs REST/SOAP;
  • Liderar iniciativas de automação de processos e workflows , reduzindo atividades manuais e aumentando eficiência operacional;
  • Utilizar e orientar o uso de recursos de Inteligência Artificial e automação (ex.: Virtual Agent, assistentes, sugestões automáticas), garantindo rastreabilidade, conformidade, privacidade e segurança.

Relacionamento, Comunicação e Liderança Técnica

  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio, fornecedores e consultorias, entendendo necessidades e traduzindo em soluções técnicas;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para analistas juniores e plenos, apoiando no desenvolvimento técnico da equipe;
  • Garantir documentação técnica e funcional completa e atualizada (processos, integrações, manuais e registros de mudanças).


Para esta posição procuramos talentos que tenham:

  • ServiceNow (Avançado): sustentação, administração e evolução da plataforma;

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

We are seeking a motivated and professional Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our team. 4. Qualifications

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

title: Especialista em  Automação e Software
description:
Sobre a Gruen


Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

title: Event Operations Specialist
description:
About the job


Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.


Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.


Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.



Who we are


We’re a real Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.


Through our years, we’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from the ground up—with our own team.


Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.



The Opportunity


The Event Operations Specialist provides hands-on support in the planning and delivery of ecoPortal’s sponsored and community events. Working closely with the Events Manager, Events Operations Specialist, Events Co-ordinator, and the wider Marketing team, this role helps ensure events are well-organised, engaging, and run smoothly from start to finish.


By seamlessly overseeing all aspects of event coordination—from initial planning through to post-event analysis—this specialist will play a pivotal role in solidifying and expanding ecoPortal’s influence and engagement globally.


This is a mid- senior role and would suit someone who is passionate about events, is unflappable in the face of multiple competing priorities, has the willingness to jump in and take charge of a large portfolio of events with a cool, calm head.



Key responsibilities


Event Management

  • Plan and execute successful sponsored events in NZ, AU and UK/EU. Full end-to-end management including but not limited to trade shows, conferences, lunches/dinner, awards.
  • Event management includes third party liaison, run pre-event briefings, manage swag, budgeting, logistics, and post-event analysis.
  • Execute full event debriefs at the conclusion of each event, and disseminate thai information to appropriate stakeholders for consideration. And, make recommendations for improvements and future attendance.
  • Collaborate with the Sales team for pre and event follow up and communications.
  • Work closely with the content and creative teams on all event related comms, branding, promotion, collateral and associated marketing.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (sales, customer success, marketing, and product) to ensure events align with overall business objectives and provide value to attendees.
  • Evaluate the success of events and report on key metrics, including attendance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, and ROI.


Community Engagement and Activation

  • Alongside the Head of Events, research the best H&S events in our target regions and recommend future events.
  • Lead ecoPortal's involvement in health and safety networks, infiltrating key communities, where applicable, attending industry gatherings, and establishing partnerships to strengthen ecoPortal’s reputation and presence.
  • Seek out bespoke opportunities for ecoPortal to participate in local, intimate, and partner industry events to increase brand awareness.
  • Develop and manage relationships with our prospects, customers and those in the Health and Safety industry and build a sense of community within ecoPortal’s customer base.
  • Develop and manage relationships with industry influencers, thought leaders, event organisers, and industry professional organisations.



Qualifications & Experience

  • A willingness and a passion to jump in and enjoy the sometimes hectic and unpredictable nature of events!
  • A Bachelor's degree in a suitable field (this may include, but is not limited to these majors) - Business, Marketing/Events, Management, Communications.
  • A minimum of 3 years experience in business events design and execution
  • Very strong organisational skills, you will be dealign with multiple events at any one time and this means you'll need to be an admin wizard.
  • Excellent attention to detail. Managing events across such a busy event calendar means honing in on details, and ensuring all your ducks are in line to ensure smooth execution.
  • Clear and confident communication skills, both written and verbal. With lots of balls in the air it's important that you know how to stay cool and calm, and focused on the task at hand.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment.
  • A proactive, can-do attitude with a willingness to take initiative. This is a senior role - and the expectation is that you'll be able to take ownership of a certain portion of events + mentor and guide others in the team who are more junior.
  • Team player with strong interpersonal skills and a customer-first approach.
  • Previous experience in events, customer service, or marketing is an advantage.
  • Comfortable using Google Workspace (Sheets and docs, and familiarity with marketing tools like Trello and Hubspot a bonus).



Perks & Benefits:

We hope that you're excited by the possibilities that come with working at ecoPortal! In addition to our welcoming and diverse culture, we also offer these fun perks and benefits.


37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.


End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.


❤️

A Labortec é uma empresa de consultoria especializada em Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho, Saúde Ocupacional e Medicina do Trabalho, com sede em Curitiba/PR. Atuamos na elaboração de documentos técnicos e assessoria a empresas de diversos segmentos no cumprimento das Normas Regulamentadoras.

Elaboração de Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos (PGR) conforme NR-01, Laudo Técnico das Condições Ambientais do Trabalho (LTCAT), Avaliação Ergonômica Preliminar (AEP), Análise Ergonômica do Trabalho (AET), Programa de Proteção Respiratória (PPR), Programa de Conservação Auditiva (PCA), laudos de insalubridade e de periculosidade. Reconhecimento de riscos ambientais nos ambientes de trabalho dos clientes. Interpretação de resultados analíticos de laboratório e enquadramento conforme os limites de tolerância das NR-15 e ACGIH. Atuação como assistente técnico em perícias trabalhistas, incluindo acompanhamento de diligências periciais, elaboração de quesitos e análise crítica de laudos periciais. Emissão de pareceres técnicos e recomendações de medidas de controle.

Requisitos obrigatórios

Formação em Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho, Tecnólogo em Segurança do Trabalho ou Engenharia com especialização em Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho, com registro profissional ativo no respectivo conselho de classe (MTE, CRT ou CREA/CONFEA). Experiência comprovada na elaboração dos documentos técnicos mencionados (PGR, LTCAT, AEP, AET, PPR, PCA, laudos de insalubridade e periculosidade). Experiência com assistência técnica em perícias trabalhistas e elaboração de quesitos. Domínio na realização de avaliações quantitativas em campo e no manuseio de equipamentos de medição de agentes ambientais. Conhecimento das Normas Regulamentadoras aplicáveis, em especial NR-01, NR-07, NR-09, NR-15, NR-16, NR-17 e legislação previdenciária (IN PRGPS 128 e Decreto 3.048/99). CNH categoria B. Disponibilidade para viagens. CNPJ ativo para emissão de nota fiscal.

Diferenciais

Certificação em Higiene Ocupacional (ABHO). Experiência com avaliação de agentes químicos e interpretação de laudos laboratoriais. Conhecimento em legislação previdenciária aplicada ao LTCAT.

Modelo de contratação

Pessoa Jurídica (PJ). Valor do contrato: R$ 5.000,00 a R$ 9.000,00 mensais, conforme experiência e volume de trabalho.

Local de atuação

Curitiba/PR, com disponibilidade para viagens a clientes em outras localidades.
